column8: It wasn't native then, and that was a choice. Left at the camera's own 4:3, the preview showed as a small square in the middle of the Seeker's tall screen, too little picture to judge how far away to stand. So the preview and the counter were set to a taller 9:16 crop of the sensor. The debug video was never set, so it kept the full 4:3, which is why the video shows more than the counter saw. It is native now: commit 40d0351, on the evening of 29 Sep, put the counter, the preview and the video on one 4:3 picture, at the cost of a shorter preview, and every sitting since 1 Oct is read in it. This sitting is older (720×1280 in its trace). On this rep's push your near knee was within 13% of the crop's edge in 5 of its 8 frames, and in the first three of those your foot was off the side of the crop. In one more frame the model put the knee almost on the ankle, where it cannot be read. That leaves the knee unseen for 75% of the push. The build you used counted the rep from the knee position the model placed there. That evening, after your sitting, commit 7e0ce20 added a rule refusing a rep whose knee spends more than a quarter of the push at the picture's edge. The rule was tightened on 1–2 Oct, today it says "Keep your legs in the picture", and today's counter refuses this rep with it. Since 4 Oct (commit 6f943cc), sittings read in the old crop are left out of scoring. Nothing to change; "unseen" is right.

column8: Same reason as for your other reps in this sitting. Since the evening of 29 Sep (commit 40d0351) the counter reads the full 4:3 picture, the same one the video shows, and every sitting from 1 Oct is read that way. This sitting was recorded earlier that day, when the counter still read a narrower 9:16 crop (720×1280), the middle three-quarters of the video's width. On the way up your right foot was off the side of that crop for most of the push, and the model put your right knee only about 9–12% in from that edge. Today's counter doesn't trust a knee that close to the edge: when a knee leaves the picture the model still places it just inside, so a reading there can't be told apart from a knee that is out of frame. In this crop the knee never got more than 13% in during the push, so today's replay refuses the rep with "Keep your legs in the picture". The build you recorded with didn't have that check yet and counted it. I can't tell from the numbers whether your knee was really inside that crop, so your "unsure" stays as it is. In the full 4:3 picture the counter reads now, that spot would be about 19–22% in from the edge. Your "unsure" label keeps this rep out of the bench, and since 4 Oct (commit 6f943cc) the whole sitting is out too, because it was read in the old crop. Nothing to change in the counter.
